Who first mentioned the forts in Andhra?
x:
The earliest historical reference to the Andhras possessing numerous forts is found in the writings of the Greek ambassador Megasthenes, who visited the court of Chandragupta Maurya around the 4th century BCE. In his famous work Indica, Megasthenes described the Andhras as a powerful people possessing thirty fortified towns, a large standing army consisting of infantry, cavalry and elephants, and a prosperous kingdom. His account is one of the earliest foreign descriptions of ancient Andhra.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Mentioned 30 fortified towns of the Andhras.
